iconography.realia_identification: Single-bladed ceremonial adze/axe or stylized labrys haft
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Small Axe.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/a/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 44 (Small Axe) depicts Single-bladed ceremonial adze/axe or stylized labrys haft. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_042 and Linear A AB08. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/a/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 44): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Small Axe) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/a/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
